Where did this story start, and who carried it?

When a story about Kosovo spreads, analysts find out late and cannot see where it began or who is pushing it. Give the Tracer one post, a link, a screenshot or a piece of text. It walks back through the archive to the earliest observed source, draws the path the story travelled in Albanian, Serbian and English, names who amplified it, and checks the claim against independent sources.

What this is about · lepenac · zubin · potok · online · kanala

“Detonacija u Donjim Varagama, curi voda iz kanala Ibar-Lepenac” · earliest observed at KoSSev on 29 Nov 2024, 19:05 UTC, then carried by 15 more outlet(s) over 2.0 days.

A story about an explosion in Donje Varage and leaking water from the Ibar-Lepenac canal first appeared on KoSSev on 29 Nov 2024, 19:05 UTC, and was amplified by 15 other outlets over 2.0 days. The earliest observed source is KoSSev (Tier 1, established outlet), and the story crossed from sq to sr-Latn after 2.3 hours. It was amplified by KoSSev (reach 5), Reporteri (reach 4), Sputnik Srbija (reach 4), and Insajderi (reach 3). The story is CORROBORATED, with 6 independent origin groups at tier <= 2 supporting it.

P1 · TPS 54 CORROBORATED Origin confidence 0.55 59 posts · 16 sources · 39 origin groups ✓ origin-tracing test Trigger date · Albanian Flag Day / canal attack anniversary
What we know
  • Earliest observed source: KoSSev (Tier 1, established outlet), 29 Nov 2024, 19:05 UTC. Confidence 0.55.
  • 59 posts from 16 sources in sq 29, sr-Latn 27, sr-Cyrl 3; 39 independent origin group(s).
  • Spread: 8 copy, 6 link, 4 quote, 2 translate edges; it crossed from sq to sr-Latn after 2.3 hours.
  • Amplified by KoSSev (reach 5), Reporteri (reach 4), Sputnik Srbija (reach 4), Insajderi (reach 3).
  • Verdict: CORROBORATED. 6 independent origin groups at tier <= 2 support it.
  • Priority P1 (TPS 54). TPS 54 -> P1. Tripwire forced P1: T3 + explosive/sabotage term + named critical-infrastructure site. Main drivers: how serious the labels are (1.00, 44% of score), how fast it is spreading against its baseline (1.00, 35% of score), closeness to sensitive places or dates (1.00, 18% of score). What we don't know

  • Any official (Tier 0) statement on it in the archive.
Suggested checks
